supporting_observations.claim: The supplied records for WS-TWEBER-01 in the review window are Sysmon Event ID 13 registry SetValue events from explorer.exe; none is an authentication event.
One UserAssist registry value contains a ROT13-encoded path corresponding to tom.weber's Start Menu shortcut for Slack.
Another UserAssist registry value contains a ROT13-encoded path corresponding to Microsoft Excel.
The supplied evidence does not establish whether the reported failed domain logons occurred, so it is insufficient to determine whether the alerted activity was malicious or benign.

known_telemetry_limitations: The available records are limited to three Sysmon registry-write events on WS-TWEBER-01; no domain-controller authentication records or other authentication telemetry are provided.
The UserAssist-related registry writes are not, by themselves, proof of a successful logon or of the full execution context.
claims_not_established: Whether any failed or successful domain logons for tom.weber occurred during the alert window.
The source host, source address, logon type, or cause of any reported authentication failures.
Whether the reported failures were caused by mistyped credentials, a service or scheduled task, or malicious activity.
additional_evidence_needed: DC-PIN-01 Security logs for the review window, especially failed and successful logon events for tom.weber, including source address, workstation, logon type, and status or substatus.
Authentication or endpoint telemetry from WS-TWEBER-01 for the same period to correlate any logon attempts with processes and user activity.
The original alert details and its underlying event records, including event timestamps and source host information.
